comparator.name: Bachelor International Business Administration
comparator.route: Navigating stakeholders in global business track
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official IBA programme is a three-year, 180-EC English-taught bachelor. The first two years provide a structured international foundation across business functions, research methods, law, innovation, technology and responsible leadership. Year 3 combines 30 EC of exchange, internship, minor or project choice space with advanced research and methods, Doing International Business the Dutch Way, one of three elective tracks, and a track-aligned bachelor project. Navigating stakeholders in global business is selected neutrally as the broadest general international-business route.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest curriculum covers international business, management, strategy, marketing, entrepreneurship, sustainability, leadership and stakeholder relations. The two remaining official track directions—AI for a connected world and Accounting and finance for international business—are coherent, feasible and materially distinct. Three alternatives are included, the maximum.
